versions.content: Service Name WEth_ImmediateTransmit (draft) Syntax Std_ReturnType WEth_ImmediateTransmit ( uint8 CtrlIdx, Eth_BufIdxType TxHandleId, uint8 Priority, ListElemStructType* HeaderListPtr, uint8* PayloadPtr, uint16 PayloadLength ) Service ID [hex] 0x26 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different Tx handle ids and Ctrl indexes CtrlIdx Index of the controller within the context of the Driver TxHandleId Unique transmit handle id provided by the Ethernet Interface, to identify the transmission request per physical Ethernet controller Priority Ethernet frame VLAN-priority HeaderListPtr Pointer to first Ethernet frame header of a single linked list. PayloadPtr Pointer to the payload of the Ethernet frame Parameters (in) PayloadLength Length of the payload Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Transmit request has been accepted. E_NOT_OK:Transmit request has been rejected. Description Request transmission of an Ethernet frame, where each upper layer a header part as element of a single linked list. All headers together with the payload form an entire Ethernet frame Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via EthIf.h
